title: Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities
summary: J. J. Hopfield published 'Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities' in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in April 1982. The paper described a neural-network model whose collective dynamics provide content-addressable memory from partial inputs and use asynchronous parallel state updates.
significance: A documented neural-network research milestone connecting collective dynamical behavior with content-addressable memory.
